digest.component_or_area: CLI command parsing and help system
propositions: Command syntax is fragmented across imperative argv loops, inline argparse construction, 54 hand-maintained help files, and 22 curated intercept descriptions, causing drift between parser, runtime help, and documentation.

A registry-based parser factory system with deterministic formatting must be established such that all command grammars are produced by a single side-effect-free argparse factory per command family and used by both runtime handlers and help generation.
Generated help artifacts must be byte-deterministic and authoritative, with no docs-only grammars, regex-reconstructed syntax, or duplicate parser frameworks remaining after migration.
Each command family migration must preserve existing argv acceptance/rejection behavior, diagnostics, streams, and exit codes through oracle-driven parity testing before atomic runtime switchover.

Top-level help routing and known-alias classes must serve canonical generated help bytes before operation/config/store/handler boundaries, while retired/hidden commands remain undiscoverable or unresolvable.
Execution must continue using the existing compatibility route ladder while each selected handler consumes its shared factory, ensuring rollback capability and backward compatibility.
